scope: Focused follow-up to audit PR #236 and MailCraft beta PR #212; one existing project reviewed.

baseline.original_yaml:
# Features and compatibility are maintainer-reported in the repository README and ROADMAP.
slug: ucs-mailcraft
name: MailCraft
authors: [billsecond, benandez]
repository: https://github.com/UCS-Care-Group/mailcraft
browser_url: https://playground.daijro.dev/mailcraft/
originals: [microsoft-outlook]
category: productivity
languages: [Rust]
platforms: [Windows, macOS, Linux, FreeBSD, Web]
status: beta
compatibility: partial
description: MailCraft reimplements classic Outlook's mail, calendar, contacts and tasks as a native Rust application with Outlook's ribbon, folder pane and reading pane. It signs in to Microsoft 365 and Outlook.com with OAuth, also works with IMAP/SMTP accounts, shows HTML mail without a web engine, and exposes every command to a CLI and an MCP server.
license: MIT OR Apache-2.0
docs: https://github.com/UCS-Care-Group/mailcraft#readme
limitations: Public beta since 0.8.0 (October 2026), for Microsoft 365 and Outlook.com accounts; coverage is maintainer-reported. Builds are unsigned. Send/Receive can be slow on Microsoft mailboxes with many folders and on shared mailboxes. No PST/OST/MSG/OLM import, printing or S/MIME. Browser builds cannot connect directly to mail servers.
summary: "Outlook-style mail, calendars, contacts and tasks for Microsoft 365, Outlook.com and IMAP accounts."
screenshots:
  - src: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/UCS-Care-Group/mailcraft/main/docs/images/mail-dark.png
    alt: "MailCraft: dark-themed mailbox and reading pane."
  - src: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/UCS-Care-Group/mailcraft/main/docs/images/html-mail.png
    alt: "MailCraft: formatted message in the composition window."

maturity.details: ROADMAP explicitly public beta since 0.8.0 (2026-10-24); retains PR #212 beta correction and partial compatibility.

features.details: README and current gap documents reviewed. Added Graph/shared-mailbox support, EWS mail-only scope, recurrence, rules and EML/MBOX/ICS/VCF import/export. Read-only browser JMAP confirmed by docs/jmap.md; not desktop/CLI JMAP, and not unrestricted browser mail-server connectivity.

websites.result: HTTP app shell and hosting source verified
websites.details: Existing playground demo responds with MailCraft app shell. daijro/OpenPlayground tools.yaml explicitly maps MailCraft to UCS-Care-Group/mailcraft. No new official website documented. Browser interactions not exercised.

license.result: verified in parent audit; current README confirmed
license.details: Retained MIT OR Apache-2.0. Audit #236 reviewed LICENSE-MIT, LICENSE-APACHE and NOTICE. No licensing change proposed.

platforms.details: Retained Windows/macOS/Linux/FreeBSD/Web; README/ROADMAP describe CI builds, while daily-driver beta focuses on Microsoft accounts on Windows/macOS/Linux. No platform maturity promotion inferred.

screenshots.details: Added upstream calendar-week.png and add-account.png; both return 200 image/png. README identifies screenshots as a sample mailbox.

changes.description: Retains original Outlook layout, protocols, HTML rendering and CLI/MCP details, adds current features within the 500-character limit.
changes.limitations: Retains beta/partial scope and slow large/shared Microsoft mailbox sync. Corrects obsolete browser-no-connectivity claim, records CORS/read-only JMAP, incomplete IMAP sync, admin approval, unsigned Windows/macOS downloads, missing proprietary archive imports, printing and message encryption.
changes.screenshots: Two additional representative screenshots; summary unchanged.

validation.tests: Left to PR CI under AGENTS.md; upstream code never executed.

unresolved: No independent real-account, runtime or cross-provider interoperability verification performed.
Upstream README, ROADMAP and gaps contain some stale details; catalog uses specific current protocol documentation for browser JMAP.
